acceptance.assertion: The systemd importer invokes import-outbox in a compact summary mode that emits exactly one bounded JSON line per run and excludes bundle inventories and per-source result lists.
The summary preserves aggregate error count and at most three length-bounded error samples, remains below 4096 bytes in the tested worst case and retains nonzero exit status when errors exist.
The import-outbox CLI default remains the existing full output mode so callers that do not opt into summary output keep their current result schema and detail.
The user unit adds an independent LogRateLimitIntervalSec and LogRateLimitBurst guard without changing the two-minute timer or Chronik read/write sandbox.
The Chronik role contract, focused tests, complete test suite, API smoke, GitHub CI and exact-head review pass.

A versioned exact-head deployment runs at least one scheduled import while journald records no new global user@1000.service suppression attributable to the importer, and rollback remains possible without ledger mutation.

approval.note: The user explicitly authorized implementing all sensible remediations and continued execution on 2026-07-31. Registry publication, merge and runtime rollout remain separately evidence-bound.

goal: Stoppe den durch vollständige Batch-JSON-Ausgabe verursachten globalen User-Journalverlust, ohne Chronik-Import-, Ledger-, Receipt- oder CLI-Kompatibilitätssemantik zu schwächen.

does_not_establish: permission to rewrite ledger or receipt history
general safety of arbitrary user-service output
metadata.finding: chronik-outbox-import.service produced 9,998 of 10,000 stored user-journal messages in the first 30 seconds before journald suppression, followed by roughly 42,000 suppressed messages per two-minute run.

source.locator: heim-pc journal boot 2026-07-31 05:54:59..05:55:29 CEST; chronik-outbox-import.service PID 1673710

closeout.finding: The requested bounded importer path is merged, byte-hardened, deployed and live-verified; the stale planned state was registry drift rather than missing Chronik implementation.

validation.api_smoke: health, version, agent-ledger ingest and readback passed
validation.review: Exact-head implementation review is represented by merged PR #250 plus independent local exact-revision verification in this closeout.

journal_observation.attribution: Post-initial-deployment global suppression was system-wide and not attributable to an importer emitting one bounded line per two-minute cycle; the broader logstorm is tracked separately.

rollback.method: Atomically repoint current to a preserved immutable earlier release, restore its unit, daemon-reload, and rerun the importer without changing ledger, receipt or outbox history.

acceptance_evidence.bounded-systemd-output: Live unit invokes --output-mode summary; 30 observed outputs were one-line JSON without result lists or bundle inventory, latest ten 791 bytes.
acceptance_evidence.bounded-error-signal: Adversarial Unicode and control-character tests enforce emitted bytes including newline below 4096, max three samples, aggregate error_count and nonzero failure exit.
acceptance_evidence.cli-compatibility: Default full-mode schema regression test passes and PR #250 records byte-identical full output against its base fixture.
acceptance_evidence.unit-rate-limit: Installed unit has LogRateLimitIntervalSec=30s and LogRateLimitBurst=200; service-artifact tests preserve timer and sandbox.
acceptance_evidence.validation-proof: 52 focused and 444 total tests, role contract, API smoke and five pull-request workflow runs pass on exact head.
acceptance_evidence.live-journal-proof: Current exact release executed scheduled imports successfully; no new exact global user@1000.service suppression after 2026-07-31 19:25:40, and rollback releases remain present.

establishes: T012 acceptance on the observed Chronik revision and runtime
registry eligibility for verified terminal state
does_not_establish: absence of logstorms from unrelated user services
permission to rewrite ledger or receipt history

uncertainty_causes: GitHub Actions evidence is workflow-run state plus independent local exact-head verification; no external Codex review was available because its quota gate returned a limit notice.

rollback.procedure: Atomically restore the previous immutable Chronik release and previous user unit, reload the user manager, rerun the importer, and preserve all ledger, receipt, outbox and diagnostic evidence unchanged.
rollback.trigger: The summary hides importer failure, exceeds its bound, changes full-mode output, breaks import semantics, or live suppression continues after deployment.
